CREATE FUNCTION reference_eval(label text, statement text) RETURNS jsonb LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ DECLARE output jsonb; code text; message text; BEGIN EXECUTE statement INTO output; RETURN jsonb_build_object('name',label,'sql',statement,'value',output); EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN GET STACKED DIAGNOSTICS code=RETURNED_SQLSTATE,message=MESSAGE_TEXT; RETURN jsonb_build_object('name',label,'sql',statement,'error',jsonb_build_object('sqlstate',code,'message',message)); END $$
